changeSet.author: Ganiyat
changeSet.comment: Update initial_hiv_test and confirmatory_hiv_test result values: positive -> reactive, negative -> non-reactive
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE pmtct_hts SET initial_hiv_test = jsonb_set( initial_hiv_test, '{result}', CASE WHEN LOWER(initial_hiv_test->>'result') = 'positive' THEN '"reactive"'::jsonb WHEN LOWER(initial_hiv_test->>'result') = 'negative' THEN '"non-reactive"'::jsonb ELSE initial_hiv_test->'result' END ) WHERE initial_hiv_test IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(initial_hiv_test->>'result') IN ('positive', 'negative');
UPDATE pmtct_hts SET confirmatory_hiv_test = jsonb_set( confirmatory_hiv_test, '{result}', CASE WHEN LOWER(confirmatory_hiv_test->>'result') = 'positive' THEN '"reactive"'::jsonb WHEN LOWER(confirmatory_hiv_test->>'result') = 'negative' THEN '"non-reactive"'::jsonb ELSE confirmatory_hiv_test->'result' END ) WHERE confirmatory_hiv_test IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(confirmatory_hiv_test->>'result') IN ('positive', 'negative');

changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_hts SET initial_hiv_test = jsonb_set( initial_hiv_test, '{result}', confirmatory_hiv_test->'result' ) WHERE initial_hiv_test IS NOT NULL AND confirmatory_hiv_test IS NOT NULL AND tie_breaker IS NULL AND retesting IS NULL AND confirmatory_test2 IS NULL AND tie_breaker2 IS NULL AND confirmatory_hiv_test->>'result' IN ('reactive', 'Positive') AND initial_hiv_test->>'result' IN ('Negative', 'reactive') AND initial_hiv_test->>'result' != confirmatory_hiv_test->>'result';

changeSet.comment: Create patient_person records from existing infant data (with mother's address) and link via infant_patient_uuid
changeSet.sql:
-- Insert infant records into patient_person, copying address from mother's patient_person record INSERT INTO patient_person ( uuid, first_name, other_name, surname, full_name, sex, date_of_birth, date_of_registration, hospital_number, active, archived, facility_id, is_date_of_birth_estimated, address, contact_point, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date ) SELECT gen_random_uuid()::varchar, COALESCE(i.first_name, ''), COALESCE(i.middle_name, ''), COALESCE(i.surname, ''), COALESCE(TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(i.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(i.middle_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(i.surname, ''))), ''), CASE WHEN i.sex ILIKE '%FEMALE%' THEN 'Female' WHEN i.sex ILIKE '%MALE%' THEN 'Male' ELSE COALESCE(i.sex, '') END, COALESCE(i.date_of_delivery, CURRENT_DATE), CURRENT_DATE, i.hospital_number, true, COALESCE(i.archived, 0), i.facility_id, false, mother.address, mother.contact_point, COALESCE(i.created_by, 'system'), COALESCE(i.created_date, NOW()), COALESCE(i.last_modified_by, 'system'), NOW() FROM pmtct_infant_information i LEFT JOIN patient_person mother ON mother.uuid = i.mother_patient_uuid WHERE i.infant_patient_uuid IS NULL;
-- Link back: set infant_patient_uuid on infant records using hospital_number match UPDATE pmtct_infant_information i SET infant_patient_uuid = pp.uuid FROM patient_person pp WHERE i.hospital_number IS NOT NULL AND i.hospital_number = pp.hospital_number AND i.facility_id = pp.facility_id AND i.infant_patient_uuid IS NULL AND pp.date_of_birth = COALESCE(i.date_of_delivery, CURRENT_DATE);
